_note: CANONICAL SEED for sbv_niches. The homepage renders from this inline, then overlays live rows from Supabase. This file is also the source for the INSERT block in SETUP.sql — change it here, regenerate there. Every count shown on the site is computed from this array; no count is typed into HTML.

families.name: Sale & Resale
families.note: Businesses that run on other people's things — the sale, the lot, the booth.

families.name: Haul & Clear
families.note: Something needs to leave the property, and someone has to come get it.

families.name: Curb & Exterior
families.note: Work that happens outside the house, on a route, on a schedule.

families.name: Auto
families.note: The vehicle in the driveway or the bay.

families.name: Home & Trade
families.note: Licensed trades. These are websites, not territories — the licence is already the moat.

families.name: People & Pets
families.note: Work built on trust with a person, a child, or an animal.

niches.name: EstateSaleBiz
niches.job_line: Run the whole sale when a household has to be emptied — pricing, staffing, and the day itself.

niches.name: GarageSaleBiz
niches.job_line: Run other people's garage sales in your three cities — and be the map every shopper in town checks on Saturday morning.

niches.name: Local Auctions
niches.job_line: Run the bidding for estates, farms, and storage lots — catalog, consignors, gavel.
niches.caveat: Auctioneer licensing varies by state. Check yours before you get in line.

niches.name: ConsignmentBiz
niches.job_line: Sell other people's furniture and finds on a split, without owning the inventory.

niches.name: Market Vendors
niches.job_line: Be the booth directory and sign-up desk for the markets in your county.

niches.name: Estate Sales
niches.job_line: Run the sale when a whole household has to be cleared — priced, staffed, and handed back broom-clean.

niches.name: Garage Sales
niches.job_line: Run other people's garage sales for them — sorted, priced, signed, staffed, and cleared by Sunday night.

niches.name: Junk Removal
niches.job_line: Take the cleanout calls — garages, estates, and the stuff nobody wants to load.

niches.name: Delivery & Courier
niches.job_line: Move packages across town same-day, on a zone map you set.

niches.name: Dumpster Rental
niches.job_line: Drop the container, haul it off, bill a flat rate.

niches.name: Moving
niches.job_line: Load, drive, unload — local moves priced before the truck arrives.

niches.name: Pressure Washing
niches.job_line: Take the grime off driveways, siding, and decks, quoted from a photo.

niches.name: Bin Cleaning
niches.job_line: Clean the trash bins on a route, on a schedule, every month.

niches.name: Landscaping
niches.job_line: Keep yards cut, edged, and planted through all four seasons.

niches.name: Painting
niches.job_line: Repaint rooms and exteriors — colour picked before the first coat.
niches.caveat: Homes built before 1978 need EPA RRP certification for lead-safe work.

niches.name: Roofing
niches.job_line: Repair and replace roofs, and handle the storm-damage paperwork.

niches.name: House Cleaning
niches.job_line: Clean the same houses on the same days every week, on a route you build.

niches.name: Office Cleaning
niches.job_line: Hold the keys to a handful of offices and clean them after everyone goes home.

niches.name: Window Cleaning
niches.job_line: Inside and out, screens and tracks — priced by the pane or by the house.

niches.name: Sprinkler & Irrigation
niches.job_line: Install and repair the system that keeps a lawn alive — zones, heads, valves, controllers.

niches.name: Car Detailing
niches.job_line: Bring cars back to showroom condition in the customer's driveway.

niches.name: Auto Repair
niches.job_line: Diagnose it, fix it, and explain it before the work starts.

niches.name: Auto Body
niches.job_line: Put collision-damaged panels back to factory shape.

niches.name: Mobile Mechanic
niches.job_line: Drive the shop to the driveway — the repairs that never needed a lift.

niches.name: Plumbing
niches.job_line: Fix the leak, clear the drain, replace the water heater.

niches.name: Electrician
niches.job_line: Run wire, upgrade panels, and pull the permits.

niches.name: Heating & Air
niches.job_line: Keep the heat on in January and the air cold in July.

niches.name: Contracting
niches.job_line: Take a remodel from first sketch to final walkthrough.

niches.name: Metal Fabrication
niches.job_line: Cut, weld, and build it in steel from a drawing.

niches.name: Dog Walking
niches.job_line: Walk the dogs on a weekly rhythm their owners can count on.

niches.name: Child Care
niches.job_line: Watch the kids so the parents can have the evening.

niches.name: Caregiving
niches.job_line: Keep someone company and safe in their own home.

niches.name: Personal Trainer
niches.job_line: Coach lifters and runners toward one specific goal.

niches.name: Tattoo Studio
niches.job_line: Draw it, book it, and tattoo it in a private studio.

niches.name: DJ
niches.job_line: Play the room — weddings, clubs, and anywhere with a dance floor.

niches.name: BBQ Food Truck
niches.job_line: Smoke it overnight and park where the crowd is.

niches.name: Personal Assistant
niches.job_line: Take the errands, the calendar and the chasing off a busy person's plate.
